question: How many open claims does each Texas adjuster have?

report.interpretation: Open claims (status = 'open' on the 2026-09-30 extract date) currently assigned to each of the 8 adjusters whose region is Texas. I counted by the adjuster currently responsible for the claim, across all report dates.
report.answer: The 8 Texas adjusters hold 108 open claims in total: Joseph Cole 17, Brian Torres 16, Cathy Bradley 14, Mark Jones 13, Richard Gomez 13, Scott Mcintosh 13, Derek Ortiz 11 and Jennifer Powers 11. All open Texas-region claims sit with Texas adjusters, and none of the 8 has left the company. Recently reported claims are still incomplete, so counts may rise as late reports arrive.
report.answer_sql: SELECT a.adjuster_id, a.full_name, count(c.claim_id) FILTER (WHERE c.status='open') AS open_claims FROM adjusters a LEFT JOIN claims c ON c.adjuster_id=a.adjuster_id WHERE a.region='Texas' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY open_claims DESC, a.adjuster_id
